description: Allow the Synthesaurus lab to declare browser MIDI and join Faves while preserving its lab identity and existing WAX roles. Preserve the frozen module-relocation baseline.

replacements.before: const catalogueIds = new Set(INSTRUMENTS.map(({ id }) => id));
replacements.after:

const catalogueIds = new Set(CATALOGUE_ITEMS.map(({ id }) => id));
